test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). C is sitting to the immediate left of A and immediate right of E. E is sitting to the immediate right of B. D is sitting to the immediate left of B and immediate right of F. A is sitting to the immediate left of G. Who is sitting to the immediate right of G?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

C is sitting to the immediate left of A and immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b2c3e54b1dc0c3b6ae5fce6beceb56fb3dad0a9634ffedf4738c53bce78f29e.png] 

E is sitting to the immediate right of B. D is sitting to the immediate left of B and immediate right of F.

A is sitting to the immediate left of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a58af554acfc4f44ac558f54e2c988f9780fcc0ed866fff432bbdbbdc2c6c9f.png] 

Thus, F is sitting to the immediate right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
